title: Example Project
description: This is a placeholder. Edit data/projects.json to add your own projects (see README).

title: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup
description: Find equipment, spells and consumables in a turn-based solo dungeon run. Choose a WebTiles server for browser play.

title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
description: Collect randomized gear, rings and artifacts. Download the game for a supported device from the official releases.

title: DiabloWeb
description: Fight through dungeons in real time and collect gear. The hosted port offers shareware play and requires your original Diablo data for the full game.

title: PokéRogue
description: Play on the project’s site. Catch Pokémon, collect items, and build a team across roguelite runs.

title: Pokémon Showdown
description: Build a team or jump into a random online battle in the browser.

title: Pokémon Reborn
description: Download the standalone fan RPG for a new region, story, and battles on terrain that changes how moves work.

title: Pokémon Rejuvenation
description: Download a standalone RPG set in the Aevium region, with story chapters and field-based battles.

title: Pokémon Desolation
description: Download a standalone RPG focused on story choices and exploration across the Ayrith region.

title: Pokémon Uranium
description: Download a standalone adventure in Tandor with original creatures and Nuclear-type encounters.

title: Pokémon Insurgence
description: Download a standalone RPG with Delta Pokémon, the Torren region, and optional challenge modes.

title: Xenoverse: Per Aspera Ad Astra
description: Download a standalone Pokémon fan RPG set in the Eldiw region.

title: PokéClicker
description: Catch Pokémon and battle through regions in an idle game you can play in your browser.

title: Pokémon Auto Chess
description: Draft Pokémon and build a team for battles that resolve automatically in your browser.

title: Pokémon Damage Calculator
description: Compare attacks, items, and builds across generations before a battle.

title: Pokémon Showdown Dex
description: Look up Pokémon, moves, abilities, and items used by the battle simulator.

title: PokéPaste
description: Share Pokémon teams as readable builds with moves, abilities, and held items.

title: Bulbapedia
description: Look up Pokémon mechanics, games, locations, and other series details in a community wiki.

title: Pokémon Database
description: Browse Pokédex entries, type matchups, moves, and evolution charts.

title: Legacy of Goku Trilogy Port
description: Development source and field-map import tools for bringing the first two campaigns into the Buu’s Fury engine. Story integration is in progress.
